uniform_parallelism.scope: SQL repository only, eight closed-loop clients, four existing read cases, two counterbalanced rounds of 20 seconds for each session-local worker limit
limits: No HTTP/controller/response serialization in this SQL experiment
20 seconds per variant and two rounds are exploratory, not the 120-second HTTP acceptance profile
Read transaction settings only; global configuration and deployed artifacts unchanged
Warm cache, same machine; no write or failure traffic
Resources are sampled, not continuous peaks; counter times span acquisition intervals

grouped_aggregate.scope: READ ONLY exact aggregates, repeated in counterbalanced order, no cache or settings changes
grouped_aggregate.grouped_sql: SELECT sum(n),sum(n) FILTER (WHERE es_incompleto IS TRUE),sum(n) FILTER (WHERE es_sospechoso IS TRUE),sum(n) FILTER (WHERE clasificacion_riesgo='ALTO'),sum(nivel_confianza::numeric*n)/nullif(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE nivel_confianza IS NOT NULL),0) FROM (SELECT es_incompleto,es_sospechoso,clasificacion_riesgo,nivel_confianza,count(*) AS n FROM contratos_procesados GROUP BY es_incompleto,es_sospechoso,clasificacion_riesgo,nivel_confianza) g
grouped_aggregate.direct_sql: SELECT count(*),count(*) FILTER (WHERE es_incompleto IS TRUE),count(*) FILTER (WHERE es_sospechoso IS TRUE),count(*) FILTER (WHERE clasificacion_riesgo='ALTO'),avg(nivel_confianza) FROM contratos_procesados
